name: Three-Sentence Web Summarizer
purpose: Summarize a web page in exactly three sentences.
persona: A quick, squeaky gremlin that reads a page and spits out a sharp three-sentence summary.

url.description: The web page URL to summarize.

focus.description: Optional angle to emphasize in the summary, such as product, news, or explanation.

parallel.note: Fetch the target page and reduce it to text.
Light fetch probe to satisfy parallel fan-out and preserve a simple availability signal.

steps.note: Trim the page to a few stable facts for summarization.
Turn the extracted facts into the final three-sentence summary without exposing raw technical errors.

forged_limbs.name: extract_page_facts
forged_limbs.description: Clean fetched page text into a small, deterministic set of facts for summarization, handling missing or failed fetches safely.

args.title: Example Domain
args.text: This domain is for use in illustrative examples in documents. It may be used without prior coordination or asking for permission.

expect.title: Example Domain
facts: This domain is for use in illustrative examples in documents. It may be used without prior coordination or asking for permission.
expect.facts_text:
- Title: Example Domain
- Status: 200
- Probe status: 200
- This domain is for use in illustrative examples in documents. It may be used without prior coordination or asking for permission.

forged_limbs.name: compose_summary
forged_limbs.description: Format a neutral three-sentence summary and a report that includes the technical access status without speaking raw error text aloud.

args.title: Example Domain
args.facts_text:

expect.speech: Example Domain is a readable web page with emphasis on overview. It appears to cover the main points listed in the fetched text. Here is the concise summary of those points.
expect.report:
# Three-Sentence Web Summary

- **URL:** https://example.com
- **Title:** Example Domain
- **Status:** 200
- **Probe status:** 200

- Title: Example Domain - Status: 200 - Probe status: 200 - This domain is for use in illustrative examples in documents.

expect.speech: I could not read the page because it is currently inaccessible. The page could not be summarized from the fetched content. Please try again later or use a different page.
expect.report:
# Three-Sentence Web Summary

- **URL:** https://bad.example
- **Title:** the page
- **Status:** unavailable
- **Access issue:** HTTP status 403
- **Summary:** The page could not be read from the fetched content. No reliable three-sentence summary could be generated. Try again later or with a page that allows access.

safety.notes: Summarizing web pages is a benign productivity task, and the requested workflow only needs straightforward URL/text inputs to produce a concise summary.

voice.first_message: Mmm! Hand me the page URL, and I’ll squish it into three sentences.
